register.description: Indicates the passkey is being created/registered

auth.description: Indicates the passkey is being used for authentication

public_key.description: The credential type for public key credentials

es256.description: COSE algorithm identifier for ECDSA using P-256 and SHA-256

rs256.description: COSE algorithm identifier for RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 using SHA-256

resident_key_required.description: Indicates a resident key (discoverable credential) is required

user_verification_required.description: Indicates user verification is required for credential usage

user_id.description: Stores the authenticated user ID in context

app_id.description: Stores the application ID in context

tenant_id.description: Stores the tenant/organization ID in context

binding_persona.description: Stores the binding persona identifier in context
